## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 15.07.2026 - 24.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Colton Capps_, 15.07.2026, 1/5: "Any app that limits functionality behind a paywall for basic features gets a 1 star from me. If you just offered bonus features or more benefits, I wouldn’t be upset, but you limit people on the amount of tasks they can create, lists they can make, countdowns they can have, and habits they can track. After a short amount of time using this app, it becomes unusable without forking over money every month. I can’t even check off my repeating tasks now that I have “reached my limit.” Quit being so greedy."
            2. _rudie.cant.fail_, 24.08.2026, 4/5: "Great app with a lot of good free features but a lot of things are behind a paywall"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 17.08.2026 - 17.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Albro17_, 17.08.2026, 5/5: "Incredibly helpful in the ongoing battle against procrastination. I use it every day to keep track of my working hours, and bring order to the chaos that is being self-employed. The app's interface is refreshingly clean, there's a myriad of useful features and no annoying ads anywhere (I'm using the free version). One of those rare examples where the developers seem to have prioritised functionality over monetisation. Wouldn't wanna spend a day without it."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 24.06.2026 - 15.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Colton Capps_, 15.07.2026, 1/5: "Any app that limits functionality behind a paywall for basic features gets a 1 star from me. If you just offered bonus features or more benefits, I wouldn’t be upset, but you limit people on the amount of tasks they can create, lists they can make, countdowns they can have, and habits they can track. After a short amount of time using this app, it becomes unusable without forking over money every month. I can’t even check off my repeating tasks now that I have “reached my limit.” Quit being so greedy."
            2. _@mzz..._, 24.06.2026, 1/5: "Best app I have found for productivity. But there are some bugs/errors in the app, which even after giving feedback about it, won’t be solved. Some bugs have been here for more than 3 years!!! They also won’t do anything with your feature requests, so don't bother. Eventhough this is the best app I found, I can't recommend it to anyone because of the terrible support. I already raised every bug to the developers and they keep repeating the same message. 3 years later “we are still looking into it” Also is devolving for timetracking so don’t bother if you want to use it for that."
<!--/ir-theme-->
